scope: Authored acceptance cases for a future synthetic Rust prototype
status: Implemented in the mock Rust slice; automated and native UI evidence are tracked separately in validation/milestone-2/acceptance.json. These are prototype policies, not claims about CPRS runtime.

cases.scenario: Open selection from an existing synthetic chart
cases.expected: Keep the current chart identity until another exact patient identifier is confirmed

cases.scenario: Two synthetic records have the same display name
cases.expected: Select by stable identifier and show distinguishing fields; never resolve by name alone

cases.scenario: Edit search text after choosing a row
cases.expected: Invalidate the pending selection so confirmation cannot open the previous row

cases.scenario: Older search completes after a newer search
cases.expected: Discard the older response using its request generation
Show an explicit empty result state
Show an error distinct from successful zero rows
Report a parse error without selecting another record or treating the row as valid

cases.scenario: Request the next or previous page
cases.expected: Pass an explicit cursor and direction through the provider interface; do not silently substitute prefix matching
Return to the previous chart identity without committing the pending selection

cases.scenario: Confirm without a valid stable identifier
Synthetic access policy denies the selected record
Synthetic access policy or a synthetic deceased-record flag requires confirmation
cases.expected: Require an explicit decision before committing the patient identity

cases.scenario: Press OK or double-click the selected row
cases.expected: Use the same confirmation path and apply the same mock access decisions

cases.scenario: Switch from synthetic patient A to synthetic patient B
cases.expected: Prevent delayed A data from appearing in B's header or chart view
Provide predictable focus and visible focus indication; confirm exact identity before opening
Show an explicit prototype placeholder rather than fabricated chart content
